assets.name: male ambassador portrait

assets.name: TẶNG repetition and banner copy
assets.usage: Keep the repeated giant 'TẶNG' words and the tilted banner 'HÀNG NGÀN SẢN PHẨM' exactly positioned and worded.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the ambassador identity and the exact repeated-word poster structure.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain a fun, high-energy promo style rather than a luxury editorial tone.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square BADASS promotional poster with a soft blue gradient background. Fill the background with repeated giant yellow words 'TẶNG' outlined in white, stacked vertically. Add a tilted royal-blue banner reading 'HÀNG NGÀN SẢN PHẨM'. Place the white BADASS wordmark at the top right. In the lower center foreground, place a photorealistic young Asian male ambassador with arms crossed, wearing a beige polo and light trousers, slightly smiling. Add tiny white sparkle accents near the figure. Technical style: photorealistic ambassador promo poster with bold graphic typography, bright studio-commercial lighting, high-key promotional glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry face, low resolution, incorrect Vietnamese text, distorted body, cluttered layout, weak color contrast, missing repeated background words, watermark, signature
